fluff.overview: Despite the low regard most Clans hold for conventional infantry, these formations benefit from incidental access to Clan technology that makes even a disaffected garrison Point a match for its Inner Sphere equivalent. Mechanized Tracked Points travel in tracked armored personnel carriers that offer all-terrain capability at the cost of speed. Tracked vehicles handle rough ground, mud, and snow better than wheeled alternatives, making these Points reliable in difficult terrain where faster formations would bog down. Fitted with dedicated anti-aircraft weapons alongside standard rifles, these Points provide point air defense for infantry formations and fixed installations, screening against low-flying VTOLs and conventional aircraft.
